passage:
A teacher used an online voting tool so students could answer questions anonymously during class.
Quiet students participated more. The teacher could see quickly which ideas were confusing.
But one day, some students used the tool to send joke answers. The teacher paused and discussed responsibility.
Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability.
The class agreed on rules. The tool returned the next week and worked better.
The voting system showed that technology does not automatically create good participation. Classroom culture matters. Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.

glossary.translation: 目前的；現行的；水流；電流
